name: Unscroll
subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
description:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

versions.localizedDescription: • Unscroll 1.7.12: posts drawn again at the top of the feed stay in sight
• Unscroll 1.7.11: the post you're reading stays put; hold a reel for 2×, pinch a photo to zoom
• Unscroll 1.7.10: swiping left from Home works on a busy feed; a comment sent in a chat opens its post
• Unscroll 1.7.9: swiping from Home to the DMs works again; swipes follow Explore and Reels
• Unscroll 1.7.8: no false "post vanished", an empty feed gets filled, notices can be turned off
• Unscroll 1.7.7: "Following" found by its word, not by its icons' names
• Unscroll 1.7.6: say where a vanished post went, and nudge the feed to redraw it
• Unscroll 1.7.5: swiping a carousel keeps its post too
• Unscroll 1.7.4: the post you press in stays, or says why it went
• Unscroll 1.7.3: swiping a carousel no longer makes posts vanish or flips to the DMs
